overall_analysis: Russell Investments' prediction was partially accurate but missed critical market dynamics. While they correctly identified that AI-leveraging companies would generate strong returns and that AI adoption would accelerate broadly, they significantly underestimated market concentration and the dominance of hyperscaler capex spending. Their belief that deregulation would reduce concentration proved incorrect, as the market became increasingly concentrated on mega-cap tech companies and frontier AI producers throughout 2025.
